inspectedText: Authors measured 60 microliter deionised water drops trapped on heated brass ratchets. Bare brass lifetime falls to seconds in the boiling regime and rises sharply beyond the Leidenfrost transition; above that transition lifetime gradually declines again. Vapor pressure supports the drop and removes direct liquid-solid contact. Coating changes the transition behavior. This supports a conditional hotter-can-last-longer statement, not a monotonic law.
